title: hypericum quadrangulum subsp. tetrapterum
intro: Hypericum quadrangulum subsp. tetrapterum, commonly known as Four-angled St. John's Wort, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the St. John's Wort family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Four-angled St. John's Wort include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include hyperforin, hypericin, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to modulate neurotransmitters, reduce anxiety and depression, and exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects.
